newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA March 25 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 1 due. Max. draft 27 ft. 9 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels. Max. draft 29 ft. 0 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Four vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 2 loading maize, 1 loading sorghum. 4 Vessels in roads, 23 due at 6 terminals. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.15 metres during next week. Pasa berth draft - 27 ft. 3 in. Fw.

Rosario - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 6 loading maize, 1 loading vegetable oil, 1 vessel in roads, 8 due. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall about 0.15 metres during next week. Villa Constitucion - No vessels, 1 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. Fw., max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - One vessel loading maize, none in roads, none due. Draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. The forecast indicates that the draft will fall bt 0.15 metres during next week. Max. recommendable draft at high tide for Mitre channel as follows - Vessels up to 22 m. beam - 32 ft. Fw, over 22 m. beam, 32 ft. Fw.

Buenos Aires - 20 Vessels in port, 25 due. Max. draft 31 ft. 6 in. Fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel. Dock sud max. draft - 29 ft. Fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Two vessels loading sbmp, 2 in roads, 4 due. Max. draft at entrance channel 40 ft. 0 in. Bahia Blanca - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 loading sfo, 1 loading barley. 2 Vessels in roads, 6 due during the week, draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, March 25 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 Bulk wheat discharger, 1 granite loader, 1 vehicle discharger, 1 steel products discharger, 2 cellulose loaders, 1 general cargo/container discharger/loader, 1 pig iron loader. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel - 2 Cellulose loaders. 15 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 1 bulk diesel oil loader, 3 containers, 1 bulk cement, 3 bulk chemical products dischargers, 1 general cargo/container loader/discharger, 1 general cargo discharger/loader, 1 pellets loader, 1 bulk soya loader, 1 container discharger, 4 container loaders/dischargers, 2 bulk lpg dischargers. 8 Vessels waiting in roads, 65 due.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Steel products loader, 1 iron ore discharger. Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 container discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 2 fertiliser, 3 pellets loaders, 2 soya loaders, 3 general cargo loaders. 38 Vessels waiting in roads of which 16 pellet loaders, 3 general cargo loaders, 17 soya loaders. For discharging, 1 fertiliser, 1 general cargo. 23 Vessels due. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 2 full container loaders, 1 wheat discharger, 1 chemical products discharger, 1 rice loader. 13 Vessels due. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 1 wheat discharger, 2 steel product dischargers, 2 general cargo dischargers, 1 passenger, 1 paper discharger, 1 salt discharger, 1 garlic discharger, 1 oil discharger, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 2 Vessels, 30 due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 3 Vessels berthed, four waiting in roads, 5 due.

CHILE, March 24 - Arica - Three vessels in terminal, 3 berths vacant, 10 due during the week. Iquique - One vessel working normally, 6 berths vacant, 9 due durg the week. Antofagasta - Six vessels berthed, 1 berth available. 8 Vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - Seven vessels berthed working normally, 1 berth vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement. 14 Vessels due during the week, 1 day delay can be expected. San Antonio - Eight vessels operating, 2 berths vacant. 14 Vessels due during the week, port busy, but no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed working normally, 3 due, none in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed working normally, 4 due during the week, 1 day berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 2 Vessels due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel. Lirquen - Four vessels berthed, 2 berths vacant, 1 vessel due during the week. Penco - No vessels. Puerto Montt - Two vessels in port of which 1 passenger, 1 ro-ro. 5 Vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - Eight vessels berthed of which 1 passenger, 1 fishing vessel, 1 general cargo, 5 others, 6 due during the week.

PERU, March 24 - Callao - Four vessels in bay, 6 in pier (general cargo,containers), no berthing delays. Paita, Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels. Talara - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One vessel in bay, 2 in pier (fishmeal), no berthing delays. Ilo - Three concentrates vessels in pier, no berthing delays.
